terminals.name: gateway
terminals.command: set -a; source .env; set +a; export PATH="$PWD/target/debug:$PATH"; MATCHPLANE_HTTP_ADDR=0.0.0.0:8080 matchplane serve gateway

terminals.name: payment-service
terminals.command: set -a; source .env; set +a; export PATH="$PWD/target/debug:$PATH"; MATCHPLANE_HTTP_ADDR=0.0.0.0:8081 matchplane serve payment-service

terminals.name: web
terminals.command: set -a; source .env; set +a; export BETTER_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:4173 MATCHPLANE_GATEWAY_INTERNAL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080 MATCHPLANE_GATEWAY_ADMIN_TOKEN=matchplane-development-gateway-admin MATCHPLANE_PAYMENT_INTERNAL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8081 MATCHPLANE_PAYMENT_ADMIN_TOKEN=matchplane-development-admin; bun run --cwd web dev
